source: Hand-written from 15-provider-driver.md §2.7, §4.3, §4.10 and §6 and the ACP schema of @agentclientprotocol/sdk 1.6.0 (the pinned client); no adapter or CLI was run. The JSON-RPC error frames of c-11 are the pinned SDK's own replies. The scrubbed maintainer recordings against a user-installed claude-agent-acp 0.93.0 live in ../2.1.x/ (c-01, c-05, c-06, c-07, c-08, c-09, c-16, c-28); the cases here are the ones no recording can show (an option set without allow_once, unknown and malformed requests, stale and twice-given answers, the handover timeout, the turn-end mapping, auth_required, drift, decline and empty answers). Two cases follow what the recordings showed: c-21's prompt usage is per turn, and c-09's forms carry the question in message and a header in the field title. The clacp test fixture (Apache-2.0, at e6681d2) is in ../2.1.x/ with its attribution.

capabilities.note: the 15 §3 row C3 design values as ClaudeAcpDriver reports them, with usage.rateLimits false until a recording shows _meta["_claude/rateLimit"]
